question: In which of the following months was Charaideo Maidam in Assam included in the UNESCO World Heritage Site list under the cultural category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mon Jul 01 2024 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Charaideo Maidam in Assam was included in the UNESCO World Heritage Site list under the cultural category on **Mon Jul 01 2024**.
 
• Charaideo Maidam, also known as the 'Pyramids of Assam,' is a significant archaeological site in India.
 
• The site includes burial mounds of the Ahom dynasty and is a prominent example of Ahom architecture and culture.
 
• The inclusion of Charaideo Maidam in the UNESCO list helps in preserving and promoting the cultural heritage of Assam.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UNESCO World Heritage Sites**

 
 
• UNESCO World Heritage Sites are designated for having cultural, historical, scientific, or other forms of significance.
 
• These sites are legally protected by international treaties.
 
• The World Heritage Committee oversees the list and ensures sites are preserved for future generations.
 
 
 
• **Ahom Dynasty**
 
 
• The Ahom dynasty ruled the Brahmaputra Valley in Assam for nearly 600 years.
 
• Founded by Sukaphaa in 1228, the dynasty is known for its unique administrative and architectural achievements.
 
 
 
• **Archaeological Importance of Charaideo Maidam**
 
 
• The site consists of over 150 burial mounds, known locally as 'maidams.'
 
• These mounds are similar to pyramids and contain the remains of Ahom royalty and nobility.
 
• Artifacts found at the site include pottery, weapons, and inscriptions.
 
 
 
• **Preservation Efforts**
 
 
• The inclusion in the UNESCO list brings international attention and resources to help in preservation.
 
• Local and national authorities work together to maintain and promote the site.
 
• Efforts include archaeological research, infrastructure development, and tourism promotion.
